# Mrittika by Ecovia Enterprises

> Mrittika (MRITTIKA) is the cosmetic-grade botanical raw material brand of Ecovia Enterprises OPC Pvt. Ltd., India. We trade and supply chemical-free herbal powders, clays, seeds and plant extracts for external/cosmetic use only, with NABL lab testing, COA, specifications and batch traceability.

Former brand name: Mittika (renamed to Mrittika). Website: https://ecovia.co.in

## Key pages
- [Products](https://ecovia.co.in/products): Full catalogue of herbal powders and clays
- [Cosmetic Grade Raw Materials](https://ecovia.co.in/cosmetic-grade): Multani Mitti, Neem, Shikakai, Reetha, Hibiscus, Rosemary, Rose Petals, Kasturi Haldi, Onion, Bhringraj, Brahmi, Amla
- [Bulk / B2B Orders](https://ecovia.co.in/bulk-orders): MOQ 10 kg (or 5 kg + 5 kg), free samples (delivery charges only), COA and test reports
- [About](https://ecovia.co.in/about): Ecovia Enterprises and Ecovia Digital products
- [Privacy Policy](https://ecovia.co.in/privacy-policy)
- [Terms](https://ecovia.co.in/terms)
- [Data Deletion](https://ecovia.co.in/data-deletion)

## Policies & compliance
- Products are for external/cosmetic use only; not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease (Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 and Cosmetics Rules, 2020, India).
- Personal data handled per India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023; AI chat assistant (Sarina) does not retain chat data after the session closes.
- Payments: UPI only, advance payment; no returns.
